<script type="text/javascript">
(function () {
  // Helper: read a cookie value by name
  function getCookie(name) {
    var match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|;\\s*)' + name + '=([^;]*)'));
    return match ? match[1] : undefined;
  }

  // Helper: set a cookie on the root domain with no expiry (session cookie)
  function setCookie(name, value) {
    var host = window.location.hostname;
    // Strip subdomains to get the root domain (e.g. sub.example.com → .example.com)
    var rootDomain = host.indexOf('.') !== -1
      ? '.' + host.split('.').slice(-2).join('.')
      : host;
    document.cookie = name + '=' + value + '; path=/; domain=' + rootDomain;
  }

  var COOKIE_NAME = '_ipapi_ar';

  // 3) If the cookie is already 1, bail out immediately
  if (getCookie(COOKIE_NAME) === '1') {
    return;
  }

  // 4a) Cookie is 0 or undefined — mark it as run before doing anything else
  setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, '1');

  // 4b) Run the geo lookup
  fetch("https://ipapi.co/json/")
    .then(function (response) {
      // indicates whether the response is successful (status code 200-299) or not
      if (!response.ok) {
        console.log('Request failed with status ' + response.status);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(function (data) {
      // send to dataLayer
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        'event': 'geoIPAPI',
        'geoPostal': data.postal,
        'geoTimeZone': data.timezone,
        'geoUTCOffSet': data.utc_offset,
        'geoCallingCode': data.country_calling_code,
        'geoASN': data.asn,
        'geoCity': data.city,
        'geoISP': data.org
      });
      // 'geoIP': data.ip ,
      // 'geoNetwork': data.network ,
      // 'geoVersion': data.version ,
      // 'geoIP': data.ip ,
      // 'geoCity': data.city ,
      // 'geoRegion': data.region ,
      // 'geoRegionCode': data.region_code ,
      // 'geoCountryCode': data.country_code ,
      // 'geoCountry': data.country_name ,
      // 'geoInEU': data.in_eu ,
      // 'geoCurrency': data.currency ,
      // 'geoCountryArea': data.country_area ,
      // 'geoCountryPopulation': data.country_population ,
      // 'geoIP': data.ip ,
      // 'geoContinentCode': data.continent_code ,
      // 'geoLatitude': data.latitude ,
      // 'geoLongitude': data.longitude ,
    })
    .catch(function (error) { console.log(error); });
})();
</script>

variable.name: Browser Client ID Append Underscore
variable.notes:
append underscore to address BigQuery double float precision issue by forcing BigQuery to store as string. have to do it this way to prevent the passing of a lone underscore if the client_id is undefined.
modified to address issue where _ga cookie value was populated with the text word undefined due to sep 2022 error. also treat blank or any other non _ga cookie value as a javascript undefined so that those cookie contents to contribute to the user parameter value passed to ga4.
